title: AI names colors much as humans do
summary: The trained systems approached the information-bottleneck accuracy/complexity frontier, and discrete versus continuous communication produced different efficiency patterns resembling human color naming. The paper reports 60 successful game runs across need levels, robustness settings and comparisons with 108 World Color Survey languages; this is a simulation and does not prove the origin of human language.
ai_technology: Deep-learning Speaker/Listener networks played a color-discrimination game over World Color Survey color chips; their learned naming systems were analyzed against human-language patterns.
